Please split this config in one commit, then add the new devices in another so it's more clear what changed.
Made this just the schema and put the configs into another commit: https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/entity-manager/+/82824
This might be of interest to @thu@os.amperecomputing.com

Based on your next patch to add configurations using this, it looks like this is following some fixed format, can you form a regex for that and make it part of the schema?

Since it's UUID, i would not expect it to be parameterized on `$bus` or something like that.
Yes good idea. Added a regex for MCTPd's UUID dbus string.

```suggestion
        "PldmDevice": {
            "additionalProperties": false,
```

Some fluff we usually put in new schemas. Sorry i did not comment on that last time around.
Hi Alexander. It is fixed now.
schema lgtm.
While I don't have an issue with this, it shouldn't merge until your WIP commit is reviewed.
